title: Return of the Nigerian Prince Redux: Beware Book Club and Book Review Scams (2025)
summary: This article from Writer Beware warns authors about recurring scam operations targeting the writing community, specifically book club membership scams and fraudulent book review services that follow the classic 'Nigerian Prince' advance-fee fraud pattern. The piece serves as an updated alert for 2025, documenting how scammers continue to evolve their tactics to exploit authors seeking publication and visibility.
problem_solved: Helps writers identify and avoid book club membership scams and fake book review fraud schemes that promise visibility but actually steal money or personal information.
why_valuable: Provides critical fraud awareness education for authors who may be vulnerable to social engineering tactics, potentially saving them from financial loss and identity theft.
